title: Client Name and Phone cleared from form inputs when validation fails on Email
steps:
1. Open booking modal on http://localhost:3000
2. Select 'Signature Cut' and pick slot
3. Enter Name: 'Maya Lin', Phone: '(718) 555-0199', invalid Email: 'invalid-email'
4. Accept cancellation policy
5. Click 'Confirm my visit'
expected: Form submission blocked; email highlighted in red; pre-filled Name and Phone strictly preserved.
actual: Form validation triggered, but inputs were wiped, forcing user to re-type contact profile.
remediation: Updated submitBooking() in public/app.js to preserve clientState before running validation check.

title: Unformatted Backend 500 Error Display and Lack of Recovery Guidance
steps:
1. Fill booking form
2. Simulate 500 server error via x-simulate-error: 500 header
3. Observe modal error feedback
expected: User sees styled failure alert card explaining issue, reassuring that chair hold is kept active, with 'Try again' button.
actual: Plain unstyled red text rendered at bottom of modal without retry actionability.
remediation: Implemented .booking-failure-card in public/styles.css with high-visibility icon, error explanation, and retry actionability.

title: Double-Booking Risk from Rapid Multi-Clicks within 150ms
steps:
1. Complete booking details
2. Rapidly double or triple-click 'Confirm my visit' button (< 150ms gap)
expected: Only first click dispatches HTTP request; subsequent clicks synchronously dropped.
actual: Multiple parallel requests with same hold token triggered race condition and potential 409 error.
remediation: Introduced synchronous boolean lock isSubmittingBooking = true, disabled button with aria-busy='true' and .is-loading spinner.

title: Missing Animated Loading Spinner During Booking Hold & Checkout
steps:
1. Click 'Confirm my visit' on high-latency connection
2. Observe submit button visual appearance
expected: Button renders spinning indicator with accessible busy state (aria-busy='true').
actual: Button only changed text to 'Saving your chair…' with no visual animated feedback.
remediation: Added @keyframes button-spin and .button-spinner styles in public/styles.css.

title: Multi-Instance Server Concurrency Requires Distributed Locks in Phase 2
steps:
1. Deploy application across multiple load-balanced containers or horizontal instances
2. Attempt simultaneous holds across separate instances
expected: Holds synchronized across instances via distributed cache.
actual: Single-node in-memory store and file locks do not coordinate across multiple disparate OS processes without Redis or Postgres.
remediation: Phase 2 architecture roadmap schedules migration to PostgreSQL row-level locks and Redis TTL keys.

title: Admin login empty key submission relies solely on browser HTML5 validation tooltip
steps:
1. Navigate to http://localhost:3000/admin.html
2. Leave 'SALON ADMIN KEY' input completely empty
3. Click 'Sign in to schedule'
4. Observe validation feedback behavior
expected: Clear inline accessible alert banner with aria-live='polite' announces missing key to assistive technology in addition to HTML5 tooltip.
actual: Displays native browser bubble 'Please fill out this field' with static helper text; screen readers may not announce dynamic focus without aria-invalid or aria-describedby.
remediation: Add aria-describedby linking error message container and inline red validation badge on submit.
